[Tara Henley](https://tarahenley.substack.com/), [quoting William Deresiewicz's
forthcoming
book](https://tarahenley.substack.com/p/the-end-of-solitude#details) "The End
of Solitude":

> To be an individual, the years have taught me, takes a constant effort. These
> essays are an offering to those who wish to be one, too.
